name: Can Tho
provinceNote: Can Tho now includes the former Soc Trang and Hau Giang provinces.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: Can Tho is the main city of the Mekong Delta and the base for the Cai Rang floating market. Stay a night. The market is a dawn boat trip, and a day tour from Ho Chi Minh City arrives after the best of it.
getThere: 3.5–4.5 hours by road from Ho Chi Minh City
seoTitle: Can Tho and the floating market
seoDescription: Why Can Tho needs a night, how the Cai Rang market works, and how to get there from Ho Chi Minh City.
intro: Can Tho sits on the Hau River, a Mekong branch. The riverside promenade is the evening walk. The reason to come is the water: orchards, narrow canals, and the wholesale floating market at Cai Rang.
Boats leave before sunrise. A hotel that can book the boat and a breakfast box is worth more than a fancier room in the wrong part of town.
gettingAround: Sleeper buses and private cars from Ho Chi Minh City take about four hours. In the city, walk the river and take a boat for the market. Grab is less universal here than in Hanoi; ask the hotel for a trusted car.

stayAreas.name: Ninh Kieu riverside
stayAreas.summary: The practical base, near boats and restaurants.

eat: Hu tieu soup, grilled river fish, and tropical fruit are the delta meal. The floating market sells wholesale produce; eat the noodles on a nearby boat or back in town.
interestsBody: Markets and river life. One night is the minimum that makes the dawn boat honest.

faqs.q: Is a day trip from Ho Chi Minh City enough?
faqs.a: It reaches the delta. It does not reach the floating market at the right hour. Sleep in Can Tho.

season.label: Market runs year-round
season.note: High water and holidays change how busy the boats are. The useful advice is still the clock: be on the water at dawn.
